sync.ignoredLocationHint: Copies in locations ignored for lists aren't suggested, but you can still use them.
sync.moveToRequired: Choose where the removed cards go.
sync.sideboardHint: Return where it came from puts the card back in the location (and binder pocket) it was in before it went into a deck; cards with no known origin go to the location below. Keep as sideboard leaves the card in the box and tags it "sideboard". Cards already tagged sideboard are left in the box by default.
